body.title: Add ReviewCheckpoint and writeCheckpoint/readCheckpoint/finalizeAndCleanup to a new checkpoint.ts
body.summary: New src/workflow/review-round/checkpoint.ts exporting the ReviewCheckpoint interface and the three functions exactly per the LLD's contract: reviewId literal-identifier validation, canonical repo resolution, lstat-based symlink safety before every write/delete, and a guarded temp-file+rename publish for writeCheckpoint (reusing review-report.ts's publishGuarded pattern) so a crash mid-write never leaves a corrupted checkpoint. finalizeAndCleanup copies finalOutput into durable storage before deleting .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/, never the reverse, and is idempotent when called twice. readCheckpoint treats a missing or malformed checkpoint file identically (undefined), never throwing. Plus a compile-time typecheck fixture proving the exact three-function/ReviewCheckpoint shape (matching review-report.ts's own __type-tests__ convention). Sized M: this bundles three functions plus the full symlink-safety and guarded-publish scope from the start, comparable to review-report.ts's final state rather than its initial draft.
acceptanceChecks: writeCheckpoint, readCheckpoint and finalizeAndCleanup exist with exactly the signatures in contractDetails.api, and ReviewCheckpoint exists with exactly dataModelChanges' shape
writeCheckpoint publishes via a guarded temp-file+rename primitive (never a direct writeFileSync), satisfying the atomic-write error case
finalizeAndCleanup's durable copy always precedes its .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ deletion, and a copy failure leaves the temp folder intact
readCheckpoint resolves to undefined for a missing OR malformed checkpoint file, never throwing on corruption
every write and the recursive delete are preceded by an lstat-based symlink-safety check reusing review-report.ts's established helper
the typecheck fixture compiles and fails to compile under every @ts-expect-error negative case

tests.name: writeCheckpoint writes a ReviewCheckpoint JSON record to .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/checkpoint.json containing exactly {reviewId, lastCompletedUnit}, overwriting any prior checkpoint for the same reviewId
